LESSON: UNITY OF MUSLIMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Islamic Heritage and Civilisation
Topic 7.2: Unity of Muslims

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Unity of Muslims
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the unity of Muslims important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the factors that would enhance the unity of Muslims in Kenya
2. describe the challenges that undermine the unity of Muslims in Kenya
3. practise acts that foster unity among Muslims
4. appreciate the unity of Muslims to enhance brotherhood

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
